errors.cannotReach: web_search: cannot reach the Tavily endpoint {endpoint} — try: check your network or proxy, then retry, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.missingKey: web_search: Tavily backend requires an API key — set TAVILY_API_KEY env var or `tavilyApiKey` in ~/.reasonix/config.json; free 1000/mo signup at https://tavily.com
errors.unauthorized: web_search: Tavily API key rejected — check TAVILY_API_KEY or get one at https://tavily.com
errors.rateLimit: web_search: Tavily rate-limited or monthly quota exceeded — wait, switch engines in Settings (General page), or upgrade your Tavily plan.
errors.serverError: web_search: Tavily server error ({status}) — try again later, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.parseError: web_search: Tavily returned unparseable response (HTTP {status}) — try again later
